title: TikTok in China versus the United States | 60 Minutes
summary: A 60 Minutes segment in which Tristan Harris contrasts TikTok with its Chinese counterpart Douyin. He argues that Chinese children get wholesome, time-limited content while the rest of the world gets the addictive version.
why: HN cites it in TikTok ban debates as the accessible summary of how Douyin and TikTok differ.

quote.text: tl;dw: Chinese users get more wholesome content, particularly children, along with usage limits.
